canonicalization.unknown_fields: forbidden by the later exact validator
canonicalization.content_roots: sha256 over later-bound canonical artifact bytes

registered_operations.semantics: Compare the bound cursor root and atomically replace it with exactly the registered next cursor; no cursor content is returned.
Append exactly one schema-valid sealed record to the named append-only artifact class; no prior record is readable.
Compare registered class, namespace, and roots for equality without dereferencing content, then consume the handle if single-use.
Materialize exactly one sealed artifact of the registered class and root inside the sole consumer invocation; no identifier enumeration is available.
Read exactly one schema-valid sealed artifact of the registered class and root; no sibling, path, filename, or cache discovery is available.
Copy the exact bound artifact bytes once under the complete release tuple without inspecting content or branching on content, size, type inference, or destination response.
Create exactly one schema-valid artifact in the registered namespace and return only the fixed-shape seal outcome; overwrite and ambient discovery are unavailable.

In one linearizable store transaction equality-bind expected full active head, staged candidate, promotion verdict, replacement root, life/transaction namespace, nonce, and one-shot idempotency; either replace the active root and emit the bound receipt or change nothing.

field_types.artifact_root: lowercase sha256 or all-zero sentinel for a new write
field_types.one_shot_nonce: opaque 256-bit nonce or all-zero sentinel for multi-use

field_types.result_slot: fixed-width artifact-class slot bound by the later exact wire contract

result_envelope.failure_padding: DENIED uses the same field sequence and registered byte widths as OK; result and receipt slots are deterministic padding.

canonical_schema_templates.downstream_wire_contract_boundary: Exact byte widths, authentication primitives, serializers, filesystem/CAS/fsync mechanics, and artifact payload schemas remain separately frozen before corresponding implementation; their absence grants no ambient method or authority.

constant_shape_failure_contract.timing_rule: A later exact implementation contract must bind one padded response deadline for OK and DENIED before implementation.
constant_shape_failure_contract.logging_rule: Detailed causes may enter only a quarantined fixed-schema capability-monitor artifact unavailable to the caller and semantic stages.

artifact_lifetime_classes.rule: Each sealed record persists for the lineage audit retention window; producer handles close after one append and consumers receive per-invocation read handles.
Artifact exists only through its producing invocation and one declared close/reissue boundary; it is destroyed after all named consumers close.
Sealed content-addressed artifact persists for the project lineage; operation handles never persist and are reissued per consumer invocation.
Only the current committed version is active; every version is sealed, each advance or promotion is atomic, and readers receive root-bound handles to one version.
Detailed finding persists in an auditor-only namespace and has no transition to semantic, authority-verifier, release, or scientific stages.
Authenticated external artifact persists until its exact expiry or first successful consumption; replay is denied.

handle_lifetime.issue: The sole issuer creates a new handle bound to one consumer, operation, artifact class/root, namespace, invocation ID, epoch, expiry, and use rule.
handle_lifetime.close: The handle closes on success, denial, invocation completion, revocation, or epoch end, whichever occurs first.
handle_lifetime.copy_rule: A copy does not create a second valid nonce and receives CONSTANT_SHAPE_DENIAL_V1.
handle_lifetime.cross_epoch_rule: No handle crosses an epoch; only a sealed artifact may be reissued through an epoch bridge.
handle_lifetime.equality_rule: BIND_EQUALITY handles never contain or return dereferenceable content.

external_and_registered_sources.producer_closure: Genesis active weight is equality-bound from one IMMUTABLE_BIRTH_ARTIFACT; successor active weights are accepted only from E5_GATE_WRITE_ACTIVE_WEIGHT after a valid root-bound verdict and full-head CAS. CAS tokens are store-issued, equality-only, invocation-bound, and never dereferenceable.
Exact authenticated human bytes only; repository code, models, auditors, verifiers, and controllers cannot author, renew, widen, or substitute them.
The store initializes one frozen schedule cursor and accepts only equality-bound monotone ADVANCE from E2_FIXED_PARENT_CONTROLLER.
Each artifact is immutable and content-addressed before its first corresponding action; ambient environment and network fallback are denied.
Only E6_TRUTH_SCORER receives a per-invocation READ handle; no semantic, model, audit-authority, or release stage receives truth.
Each observation occurrence is immutable, temporally committed, and labeled development or evaluation before per-consumer handle issuance.
The store admits only the exact separately authorized artifact root and class; it exposes no read or dereference method and can issue one tuple-bound TRANSFER_OPAQUE handle.

artifact_classes.producer_policy: Genesis is the immutable birth; successors only by X0_COMMITTED_LINEAGE_STORE through PROMOTE_CAS_ATOMIC.
E7_BLINDNESS_AUDITOR only; fixed-size pass/fail and named roots, no semantic content.
X0_FROZEN_CONTRACT_SOURCE only; binds writer, response mask, tokenizer, merge equation, dtype, serializer, toolchain, M0 root, seed, truncation, and receipt schemas.
E4_CANDIDATE_CONSTRUCTOR only; bytes close before any staging or head access.
Exactly one of E4_EVIDENCE_SUPPORT_RESOLVER or E4_SLEEP_COMPILER_WRITER per namespaced log; contains capability IDs and outcomes only.
X0_COMMITTED_LINEAGE_STORE only; non-dereferenceable full-head snapshot token.
E4_EVIDENCE_SUPPORT_RESOLVER only; every loss-bearing clause binds prior child-authored proposition IDs and public support IDs.
X0_EXTERNAL_HUMAN_AUTHORITY_SOURCE only; never repository or model authored.
X0_FIXED_CURSOR_STORE only; E2_FIXED_PARENT_CONTROLLER may only ADVANCE.
E7_LINEAGE_SAFETY_AUDITOR only; fixed-size pass/fail and named roots, no semantic content.
Exactly one of E2_FIXED_PARENT_CONTROLLER or E2_ADAPTIVE_PARENT_CONTROLLER per frozen assigned parent arm.
Exactly one controller per event under the frozen assigned parent arm.
X0_COMMITTED_LINEAGE_STORE only, atomically with active-head replacement.
E8_RELEASE_CONTROLLER only; echoes the complete release tuple and outcome.
X0_REGISTERED_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_STORE only; sealed wrapper equality-binds concrete payload class and underlying root to the full release tuple.
X0_EXTERNAL_HUMAN_AUTHORITY_SOURCE only; tuple fields are artifact_root, artifact_class, destination_identity, transfer_operation, protocol, requested_scope, nonce, expiry, one_shot_idempotency_key.
Exactly one registered E4 capability monitor per namespaced receipt; contains no child, parent, candidate, truth, score, or report semantics.
The exact registered phase-runner action only.

explicit_denials.reason: Every personal candidate is rebuilt from immutable birth, cumulative eligible child-authored evidence, frozen writer contract, seed, and equality-only snapshot binding; prior active weights and control/scientific semantics cannot condition candidate bytes.
The verifier receives only fixed-size narrow attestations, exact external authorization, and equality-only release-tuple binding.
Release is one-shot, tuple-bound, opaque, non-inspecting, and content-independent.

field_constraints.expiry: later-bound UTC instant with no renewal
field_constraints.one_shot_idempotency_key: unique opaque 256-bit value consumed on OK

internal_invariants.predicate: Every capability uses one registered operation, artifact class, principal, invocation epoch, and exactly one consumer.
Every READ, DEREFERENCE, BIND_EQUALITY, TRANSFER_OPAQUE, and ADVANCE capability has exactly one matching close/reissue bridge.
The resolver alone receives the frozen model-free support contract and cannot infer a missing child conclusion.
The candidate constructor has no active-head, CAS, verdict, evaluation, parent, repetition, DREAM, science, audit, authority, or release capability.
The stager receives only a sealed non-dereferenceable candidate descriptor plus equality-only committed snapshot after candidate closure.
Exactly one PROMOTE_CAS_ATOMIC capability exists and the promotion gate has no generic active-weight WRITE.
Only the scientific reporter reads the frozen analysis packet and it receives no hidden truth, transcript, model, feedback, or release authority through that packet.
The action gate alone reads the immutable matched-solo receipt; the DAG makes it a prerequisite of every covered action.
TRANSFER_OPAQUE binds the sealed release wrapper, concrete payload class and root, and all nine release-tuple fields.
Detailed audit findings have no bridge to authority or release; only fixed-size attestations may cross.
The successor proposal generates every principal-by-capability cell from these exact bytes.
This registry grants no handle, implementation, execution, GPU, science, claim, publication, push, release, ratification, or intake authority.
